title.narrative: Fact-finding mission in Georgia on Waste and Chemicals Management
Fact-finding mission in Georgia on Waste and Chemicals Management

description.narrative: The fact-finding mission will comprehensively analyze the waste (covering municipal, hazardous, and construction) and the chemicals management sectors. It will examine the existing gaps and bottlenecks institutional, legal, and capacity-related that prevent the country to progress towards a sustainable waste and chemicals management system aligned with the EU regulations and standards.

Det övergripande målet för undersökningsuppdraget är att bedöma den nuvarande institutionella uppbyggnaden av avfalls- och kemikaliehanteringssektorerna i Georgien och ge konkreta rekommendationer för ytterligare tekniska, institutionella, rättsliga och kapacitetsmässiga behov och förbättringar.

The overarching objective of the fact-finding mission is to assess the current institutional setup of waste and chemicals management sectors in Georgia and provide concrete recommendations for further technical, institution, legal and capacity needs, and improvements.
